meta.title: Context (dsh-context)
meta.description: Context insights and management, with dashboard, browser, dynamics and commands, for understanding how the context composites, and how it evolves.

en.agents.solo: No subagents yet — when the agent delegates work through the subagent tool, the network unfolds here
en.agents.sub: Live context of this agent and its subagents · click a node to open its session
en.agents.subSelect: Live context of this agent and its subagents · click a node to highlight it
en.agents.title: Agent Network
en.attach.fileTokensTip: Estimated: the model receives a handle with the file name, size, and an 8-character SHA-256 digest prefix — never its contents — so the cost barely moves with the file's size
en.attach.imageTokensTip: Estimated token cost via DeepSeek's official image-size conversion ({cap}-token cap per image)
en.attach.title: Attachments
en.balance.title: DeepSeek balance
en.brief.inputTip: What entered after the previous reply and before this request went out — usually the previous tool-call results; a turn opener has nothing new
en.brief.replyTip: What the model returned on this step (a text reply or tool calls) — results of calls made here appear in the In row of the next bar
en.brief.turnTip: The user message that opened this turn — every step of the turn recalls it
en.browser.approx: Some removed messages of this step exceed retention — the makeup below is approximate
en.browser.base.tip: Diff baseline: the previous step, or the previous turn’s last step — with no predecessor, everything counts as change
en.browser.dnaTip: One band per item in the order the model reads the context — system prompt, tool schemas, then messages chronologically; the list below runs that order bottom-up with the newest message on top. Hover for details, click to open its row
en.browser.headerMetaOnly: This environment cannot fetch header content on demand; token estimates only
en.browser.kindTip: Filter replies by content kind: thinking, tool calls, or answer text
en.browser.loading: Loading full content from older session history…
en.browser.mapEmpty: Nothing to map — this step’s context is empty
en.browser.mapTip: Block map: regions sized by tokens, with same-kind items grouped into one block (e.g. every bash result together); hover for figures, click a block to open its rows below
en.browser.missingLive: … {n} earlier messages are also part of the context (outside the served window)
en.browser.noContent: Full content is outside the loaded message window (load older history in Chat to view)
en.browser.noEpoch: The header content (System Prompt / Tool Schemas) of this step is outside retention
en.browser.noHeader: Served by an older plugin build: token estimates only, no content
en.browser.noSystem: This request header carried no system prompt
en.browser.notInLog: This item is not in the session log anymore (it may have been compacted away or cleared)
en.browser.rowNoMatch: No rows match the current filter
en.browser.search.assistant: Filter by reply, calls, or thinking…
en.browser.stepAtTip: First carried by the Turn {t} · Step {s} request
en.browser.stepPendingTip: Expected in the Turn {t} · Step {s} request (not yet sent)
en.browser.title: Context Browser
en.cmd.desc: View current context makeup, browse per-step composition
en.cmd.label: Context
en.cmds.coverageFailed: Loaded {n} runs; older ones could not be loaded
en.cmds.derivedTip: Timing and exit derive from the call/result envelopes — this log has no job records, and parallel calls can overstate durations
en.cmds.empty: No commands executed in this session
en.cmds.exitInferredTip: Inferred: a clean exit logs no exit marker
en.cmds.noMatch: No commands match the current filters
en.cmds.rail.attentionTip: Session-wide highlights, independent of the list filters; clicking one applies its lens, and a keyword lands in the filter box when the lens has one.
en.cmds.rail.summaryTip: Cumulative session totals, independent of the list filters. Runs take their tally when a command settles, so a still-running command joins later.
en.cmds.rail.topScope: For each program, ×N counts recognizable invocations and N runs counts the loaded run records containing it; repeats within one record still count as one run. Both stay independent of list filters. Clicking a program filters runs containing it; clicking again clears the filter. Unresolvable primary heads group under shell/pwsh.
en.cmds.result.empty: No text output in this result
en.cmds.result.failed: Result failed to load — collapse and expand to retry
en.cmds.revealTip: Reveal this run’s result message in the Context Browser
en.cmds.sortTip: Sort commands by recency or by wall time (slowest first)
en.cmds.title: Command Executions
en.detail.loadFailed: History failed to load — click to retry
en.events.empty: No context events yet (compaction, injections, model switches appear here)
en.events.title: Context Events
en.files.deltaTip: Line change estimated from edit/write call arguments of the listed files: + added / − removed
en.files.empty: No file reads, writes, or searches in this range
en.files.locate: Reveal this operation in the Context Browser
en.files.noMatch: No files match the current filters
en.files.readEst: Lines read, estimated from the limit argument
en.files.sort.name: By name
en.files.sortTip: Sort files by operation counts (of the selected kind when a kind chip is active), line changes (added plus removed), most recent activity, path, or file name
en.files.title: File Activity
en.fleet.comms.clipped: {n} excerpts — open one for the full text
en.fleet.comms.detail.noReport: This settlement carried no closing report
en.fleet.comms.detail.originTip: Inter-agent messages are recorded in the recipient session log; the sequence locates the event
en.fleet.comms.detail.settledNote: Runtime settlement notice — not a message the child authored
en.fleet.pulse.delegationNote: A durable creation and initial-delegation record from the parent log; not counted as a message.
en.fleet.pulse.selectEvent: Select a timeline node or stream event to inspect its full record.
en.fleet.pulse.subtitle: Message traffic, active lanes, and delegated work across the agent network, on one timeline.
en.fleet.pulse.taskLaneTip: Numbers identify team tasks; colors follow their owning agent. Repeated numbers are the same task. Hover to link records, or click to filter and reveal the task.
en.fleet.pulse.title: Multi-Agent Fleet
en.fleet.tasks.noTeam: No tasks yet — team tasks and subagent delegations land here
en.footer: Token amount: “Estimated” uses the same fixed-density heuristic as DeepSeek Harness’s built-in tokenMeter (~4 chars ≈ 1 token); “Actual” is provider-reported usage.

en.stats.answersJump: Filter Answers in the Context Browser
en.stats.billedTip: Token usage is the billed total: uncached input, cache read, cache write, and output.
en.stats.cacheHitTip: Cumulative cache-read share of billed input across the session.
en.stats.commandJump: Filter this program in Command Executions
en.stats.commandsMoreTip: Scroll to the Command Executions card
en.stats.costAmbiguous: Not priced: {p} / {m} has {n} models.dev entries with different rates.
en.stats.costInferredNote: This price is a reference estimate; the provider may not list this exact model.
en.stats.costNotListed: Not priced: {p} / {m} is not in the models.dev price book.
en.stats.costPriceBy: Priced as listed on models.dev for {p} · {m}.
en.stats.costTip: Estimated cost for this agent and every descendant subagent session, for reference only.
en.stats.costTipCny: The CNY display converts at 1 CNY = 0.15 USD.
en.stats.costTipDeepseek: DeepSeek’s models.dev rates are its off-peak rates; peak windows (Beijing Time Monday–Friday 09:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00) bill at twice the listed rate, while Saturday and Sunday are off-peak.
en.stats.costUnavailable: Model prices are unavailable (retrying automatically) — the cost cannot be estimated yet.

en.stats.ownCostTip: Estimated cost of the current agent session alone (no subagents), for reference.
en.stats.skillsJump: Open Skill Injections in the Context Browser
en.stats.subCostTip: Summed estimates of every descendant subagent session’s own cumulative cost — all levels of the subtree (same basis); the current agent is not included.
en.stats.title: Context Stats
en.stats.toolJump: Open this tool's results in the Context Browser
en.stats.toolsMoreTip: Open every tool result in the Context Browser
en.stats.userJump: Open User Messages in the Context Browser
en.stats.userTip: User messages and question answerings in current session.
en.timing.empty: No timing data yet — durations appear as the conversation runs
en.timing.strip: Timing strip: slices packed in occurrence order, width as share of the active time; ticks at zero, the quartiles, and the full span
en.timing.title: Timing Stats
en.timing.toolsBusyTip: Busy time with at least one tool running. Per-call durations sum to {total}: parallel runs overlap, and runs outside a step window or awaiting the user are not attributed.
en.timing.tpsTip: Output speed (TPS): summed decoded output tokens over summed decode time — the same pairing as the harness session stats.
en.tokens.answersTip:
What Answers counts:
• Reply prose replayed in the prompt
• Reply prose generated in the output
Excludes reasoning, tool-call arguments, and tool results.
en.tokens.title: Token Stats
en.tokens.toolCallsTip:
What Tool Calls counts:
• Call names and arguments, replayed in the prompt and generated in the output
• Tool results: everything the tools returned
Excludes model replies and reasoning; tool schemas are counted separately.
en.tool.hitsTip: Times this tool was called and answered within the shown step’s context
en.tool.noMatch: No tools match the current filter
en.tool.plugin: The registering plugin of this tool (for reference)
en.tool.search: Filter by name, description, or parameters…
en.tool.sort.name: By name
en.tool.sortTip: Sort tools by call count in the shown step (default), token size, or name
en.tool.unknownTitle: The tool was registered before the context plugin loaded, or its plugin has been unloaded, so its provider cannot be determined
en.trend.adaptiveHint: Rescale bar heights to the visible range, following the scroll
en.trend.dnaTip: Draw each bar as that request’s context fingerprint — one band per item in the order the model reads it; with Delta, each band shows that item’s change against the previous bar. Hover for the item, click to reveal it in the Context browser, and every bar lights the same item’s lifetime
en.trend.durationTip: Overlay each step’s active time (step start to end — model and tool calls, excluding waits for your decisions or answers) as a curve over the bars, read off the quartile axis on the chart’s right; turn granularity sums a turn’s steps
en.trend.empty: Send a message and each model request’s context makeup shows up here
en.trend.overviewTip: Fit every retained step/turn across the pane’s visible width: no horizontal scrolling, nothing extra to load; flags mark the quartiles and the full span. Hover to read, click to pin; exclusive with DNA mode and Adaptive
en.trend.title: Context Trend
